A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VL-ICL Bench study, with complete main text and Appendices A-D. Their text, equations, tables and rendered figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v3 reports original VLLM benchmark experiments, including image-to-text and text-to-image results in Tables 2-3 and supplementary experiments in Appendices B-D.

after.justification: v4 retains these original benchmark results, model comparisons, ablations and qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: The benchmark construction, model components and in-context inference procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: The same ten benchmark tasks, VQA/captioning evaluations, text-only comparisons and supplementary test scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including the three LLaVA-OneVision sizes in Figure 7 and the base/instruction-tuned models in Table 40.

E3.justification: The Fast Open-Ended MiniImageNet panel in Figure 7 changes its final shot count from 8 to 5, and Table 40 changes its final column from 8-Shot to 5-Shot. These revise the reported settings without establishing that experiments were rerun. Table 63 still retains an inconsistent 8-Shot heading.

E4.justification: The model-size, instruction-tuning, context-extension, prompting and other supplementary analyses are retained. The shot-label corrections do not introduce new analyses or additional evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions state three random seeds in Section 4.1 and retain the same averaging and uncertainty reporting in the appendix tables.

E6.justification: Accuracy values, model rankings and qualitative findings are unchanged. Figure 7 and Table 40 revise shot-count labels rather than performance values; these reporting corrections are covered under E3 and P2.

T1.justification: The ICL formulation in Equation 1, task definitions and ICL-efficiency reasoning are unchanged. No formal assumptions, proofs or derivations are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same benchmark contributions and claims about existing ICL evaluations and VLLM capabilities.

C2.justification: Interpretations of model size, context length and instruction tuning are unchanged, as are the qualitative error discussions and limitation concerning limited text-to-image model coverage.

D1.justification: Model configurations, decoding instructions, prompts, dataset sampling/filtering details and project access information remain unchanged in Section 4.1 and Appendix A.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and research positioning in Section 5 are unchanged.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp changes, from v3 dated 2 February 2025 to v4 dated 31 March 2025. Prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 7's Fast Open-Ended MiniImageNet panel is redrawn with a five-shot endpoint and corresponding horizontal spacing. Table 40's final column heading changes to 5-Shot. The remaining figures, tables and document layout are retained.

improvement.justification: The revised shot labels improve consistency with five-shot reporting already present in Table 20 and Figures 8 and 12, reducing misleading descriptions of experimental conditions. The benefit is limited: scores and conclusions are unchanged, and Table 63 still retains a conflicting 8-Shot heading.
